title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Position Increased by Aperio Group LLC

organizations.name: aperio group llc  aperio group llc

text:
Aperio Group LLC raised its holdings in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 1.6% in the third quarter, according to its most recent Form 13F filing with the SEC. The institutional investor owned 3,483,623 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after buying an additional 55,456 shares during the period. Apple comprises approximately 3.5% of Aperio Group LLC’s investment portfolio, making the stock its biggest position. Aperio Group LLC owned approximately 0.07% of Apple worth $786,393,000 as of its most recent SEC filing.
Other large investors have also modified their holdings of the company. Rockland Trust Co. increased its holdings in shares of Apple by 10.7% during the 2nd quarter. Rockland Trust Co. now owns 20,820 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $3,854,000 after buying an additional 2,012 shares during the last quarter. Versant Capital Management Inc increased its holdings in shares of Apple by 13.1% during the 2nd quarter. Versant Capital Management Inc now owns 9,970 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $1,845,000 after buying an additional 1,156 shares during the last quarter. Stonebridge Capital Management Inc. increased its holdings in shares of Apple by 464.1% during the 2nd quarter. Stonebridge Capital Management Inc. now owns 54,246 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $10,058,000 after buying an additional 44,630 shares during the last quarter. Clinton Group Inc. acquired a new stake in shares of Apple during the 2nd quarter worth $2,066,000. Finally, First American Trust FSB increased its holdings in shares of Apple by 21.5% during the 2nd quarter. First American Trust FSB now owns 67,601 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $12,514,000 after buying an additional 11,951 shares during the last quarter. Hedge funds and other institutional investors own 57.04% of the company’s stock. Get Apple alerts:
A number of analysts have recently commented on the company. Canaccord Genuity restated a “buy” rating on shares of Apple in a report on Friday. Royal Bank of Canada reaffirmed a “buy” rating and set a $185.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Friday. UBS Group reaffirmed a “buy” rating and set a $180.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Monday, January 14th. JPMorgan Chase & Co. reaffirmed a “buy” rating and set a $228.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Friday, January 11th. Finally, HSBC cut shares of Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating and decreased their price target for the stock from $200.00 to $160.00 in a research report on Wednesday, January 9th. Three research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-four have assigned a hold rating and twenty-two have assigned a buy rating to the company’s stock. Apple presently has an average rating of “Hold” and an average price target of $195.74.
Apple stock opened at $156.82 on Friday. Apple Inc. has a 52 week low of $142.00 and a 52 week high of $233.47. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87, a current ratio of 1.12 and a quick ratio of 1.09. The company has a market capitalization of $766.07 billion, a P/E ratio of 13.17, a PEG ratio of 1.48 and a beta of 1.23.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its earnings results on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $2.78 by $0.13. Apple had a net margin of 22.41% and a return on equity of 48.68%. The company had revenue of $62.90 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $61.55 billion. During the same quarter in the prior year, the firm earned $2.07 EPS. The company’s revenue was up 19.6% compared to the same quarter last year. Equities analysts forecast that Apple Inc. will post 12.1 EPS for the current year.
In other Apple news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the stock in a transaction that occurred on Monday, November 19th. The shares were sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total value of $647,520.00. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now owns 8,940 shares in the company, valued at approximately $1,698,600. About Apple
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
